description: The build role for an autonomous pipeline. Use this kit when an agent's whole job is to implement exactly ONE task from a plan — test-first — prove its gate passes, and report a structured result, with no memory of any other task and no view of the wider system beyond what was handed to it. The kernel delivers this kit fresh on every dispatch (including after an account rotation), so the agent is always stateless. Do NOT use this kit to plan, re-scope, coordinate, commit, or merge — that's the architect, mastermind, and kernel.
